changelog:
Initial release of Surreal Art Generator.

- Generate surreal AI art in Dali, Magritte, and other dreamlike styles using the Neta AI image generation API.
- Supports a wide range of surreal and absurd imagery (melting clocks, floating objects, bizarre creatures, impossible architecture, and more).
- Accepts custom prompts and options for image size and style inheritance.
- Perfect for social posts, album covers, gallery prints, and concept art.
- Requires a free Neta API token for use.
